name: Octree Voxel Color Retrieval
definition: Retrieves the color of a voxel from the octree data structure, applying lighting if not shadeless. It navigates the tree to find the leaf node containing the color data.
summary: Octree Voxel Color Retrieval fetches voxel colors from a sparse voxel octree and applies lighting, distinguishing itself by traversing the tree to leaf nodes for data extraction.
